units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. You have one day, and tonight we have about twelve minutes.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And tonight's theme is the spooky stuff.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: With one rule. We keep legend and history in separate boxes.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Useful. When you stand in front of a statue tomorrow, you'll know which kind of story you're hearing.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Fine. I'll say it out loud. A legend is a story.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Five chapters. A giant, a shapeshifter, a stone fortress, a riot, and a massacre.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The first three are legends. The last two are real.
